note: Wooded hill area north of Stockton with a restored savanna. The designated primitive camping area is in the woods just north of the area's only parking lot, a gravel lot off County Road 724 on the south boundary. No facilities; spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Designated Camping Sites' - one designated area 'on the south edge of the property ... just north of the parking lot' - free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. Pin is the GIS camping point ~45 m north of the lot. Not waterfront confirmed. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page: 'Primitive camping is available on the south edge of the property in a designated area located just north of the parking lot.' Map (07/10) shows one Primitive Camping Area symbol just north of the lot on County Road 724; GIS layer 27 has one point (325, 37.78628,-93.76132 = stored pin) in the woods ~20 m north of the lot's north end, and layer 26 one lot (414, 37.78583,-93.76132; GIS says 'Paved', imagery shows a white gravel/rock lot ~18 m x 30 m opening straight off gravel CR 724). A small clearing sits at the lot's north end; a rig would stay on the lot with the designated area beside it. A 23-ft rig fits the lot; access CR 752/1701/724 are county gravel roads, no ford. MDC designates this area in its own words, so it reads as designated camping rather than a lot allowance.
PIN: stored 37.78628,-93.76132 = GIS camping point, ~45 m north of the lot centre - fine.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed - only small ponds/drainages inside the area, none near the camping area.
PHONE: (417) 895-6880 on the area page matches.
